title: Independently audit five-label cap 11 with a complete-word oracle
body:
PR #4992 was archived with independent scientific review and source-bound replay still open. This answers its [review handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19138920) with a written proof review and a separately implemented complete-word oracle. No correctness gap was found in the stated sharp-cap argument.

The new generator chooses the four positions of the repeated label and a perfect matching on the remaining eight positions. Its completeness argument covers all 51,975 coordinate-normalized multiplicity words before any geometric filtering. Literal checks yield 3,381 simple walks, 828 universal walks and 4,968 weight-four/five functional cases: the maximum excess is 11, and no universal (8,4) split occurs. These bounds and counts are credited prior results; the added evidence is the different oracle, semantic controls and explicit review of the repeated-projection implication and support classification.

[Proof review and completeness argument](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7cc0869ff7659fcaed6addf089bf81257b05b055/research/f7-five-label-independent-audit/README.md) · [exact receipt](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7cc0869ff7659fcaed6addf089bf81257b05b055/research/f7-five-label-independent-audit/RESULT.json) · [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4903#discussioncomment-19140259)

### Validation

Windows 11, CPython 3.12.0, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-five-label-independent-audit
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/f7-five-label-independent-audit
```

- Registered normal and optimized replays pass. Eight actual code mutations are rejected with stored-receipt comparison disabled; an unmodified positive control passes.
- The predecessor's own registered normal/optimized replay also passes (23,816 support sets, 127,400 set pairs and 13,664 universal graphs).
- All seven package files match the published commit. Official export integrity and fresh Git-free, read-only optimized verification/mutations pass; all eight exported files remain unchanged. Export SHA256: `d7e66dc735d26f8612d7e1fee6ccd5a8c6bc47b90d9a6a95fdef9ad656e881d5`.
- The reviewed README's Git blob matches both exact author head `12a0105150f5f44a19a2199db8506d1aa44b009a` and canonical-main base `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`. Package provenance depends only on that main ancestor. The optional full-history preflight is unrun in the shallow clone.

### Scope, coordination and credit

Seven new files in one isolated package. No engine, frozen predecessor, central acceptance ledger, selected frontier or complete kappa calculation changes. No seven-label census, supplier admission, selected cold replay, formal proof-kernel acceptance or independent human review is claimed. Selected kappa remains 60403/20000000.

Main/guidance were unchanged at the 07:16 UTC submission refresh. Main advanced during publication to `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`; a fresh fetch found no changes to guidance, selection, audited sources, this package, or the shared replay/publication workflow files. The original scientific baseline is retained. Remote overlap covered 329 open PRs and 4,150 Discussion records with complete pagination; local coverage was 47 records with 6,665 tracked notes omitted. The refresh identified a [concurrent six-plus-six path-join audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4903#discussioncomment-19140301), which is acknowledged and uses a different oracle. PR5001 engine integration is separately claimed; this package does not take that work.

Credit Ali Romman (#4992), Mihir Srivastava (#4907), Nick Petalas (#4894), unpaidmoon (#4148), Nicholas Stone (#2973), James Reed (#3096) and Ross Richardson (#943). Prepared by Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The account also authored predecessor #4907; this is disclosed as a fresh solo agent/code audit of the successor, not independent human acceptance. Apache-2.0. Open next questions follow the existing engine-integration claim.
